blocks.text: Central Meadows homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Central Meadows, October 2026. Detached houses: 9 listed at month end and 5 sold in October, a sales ratio of 56%. Condos and townhomes: 24 listed at month end and 9 sold in October, a sales ratio of 38% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 21 sold over 5 months against an average of 17.0 listed, about 4.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 34 sold over 5 months against an average of 30.8 listed, about 4.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 9 sold.

faq.q: Which public schools serve Central Meadows?
faq.a: Pitt Meadows Elementary at 11941 Harris Road is physically in the area, and Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue is the public secondary school for Pitt Meadows; SD42 has no middle tier, and for the sample address used (12007 Harris Road), the SD42 locator gives Pitt Meadows Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary — catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator.

Pitt Meadows Station gives West Coast Express service to Vancouver and bus connections including route 701 to Coquitlam Central Station and Haney Place, route 791 to Braid Station and Haney Place, and the 719/722 Meadowtown circular service; the R3 RapidBus stops at Harris Road on Lougheed Highway.

faq.q: Is Central Meadows in a floodplain?
faq.a: The City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of Pitt Meadows lies within the Fraser River and Pitt River floodplain, and the city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes; this area is in urban drainage Area 3 of the Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District.

faq.q: Where is the main shopping and grocery shopping?
faq.a: Save-On-Foods is the grocery tenant at Meadowvale Shopping Centre on Harris Road, and Meadowtown Shopping Centre at 19800 Lougheed Highway, with Real Canadian Superstore, sits at the area's north-east edge, with further shops and services on Harris Road in the Town Centre.
